name: Weighted Hold
description: Pin a foe to the spot with a thick weight on its legs so it cannot move a pace.

name: Burden Ward
description: Hold a ward of dense weight that turns light and middling blows into a harmless drop.

name: Weight Pulse
description: Send a heavy pulse out from the user and press every foe in a ring to the ground.

name: Mass Sense
description: Feel the full weight of every body and structure in a wide space and where each one presses.

name: Crush Lance
description: Drive a lance of compressed weight through guards and bodies in one long line.

name: Gravity Cage
description: Build a cage of crossing pull about a foe so every motion draws it into the bars.

name: Iron Ceiling
description: Lower a ceiling of dense qi over the user and allies that stops great falling masses.

name: Weight Lent
description: Lend weight to every ally in range so that their blows land heavily and their stance holds.

name: Pillar Crash
description: Drop a pillar of weight from above on one great foe that strikes it down and holds it flat.

name: Downward Law
description: Make the ground itself refuse all rising so no foe in range can leap or fly.

name: Falling Realm
description: Bring the weight of a whole region down on a vast area in one great fall.

name: Weight Eternal
description: The school move that sets a weight on a field that does not lift while the user stands guarded within.

name: Planetfall
description: Call a world's weight down on a vast field and flatten everything standing to the ceiling of its tier.

name: Gravity Ruin
description: Break the pull of a whole field in one stroke so that its ground and all upon it are crushed.
